Name: Pet Interaction Redux
Author: chyrop
Description:
All credit goes to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/jahangmar]jahangmar[/url], original creator of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4232]Pet Interaction[/url] mod.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4232]Pet Interaction[/url] had no update since 2021, was broken in 1.6, and happened to be opensource on Github. I forked it and made some tweaks so it compiles for 1.6, and uploaded it thinking it might be useful to some - but I do not particularly plan to maintain it further. You can still leave a post detailing issues if you're feeling lucky.

Note that I have not tested this thoroughly. I have never even tried the original mod before it became outdated. If you have tried the original mod, it might be helpful if you leave a post saying whether it behaves the same as previously, or you notice differences.


[size=4][b]What it does:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*] Your pet can follow you (nearly) everywhere outside. It waits for you in front of the door if you enter a building. Right-click your pet tomake it follow you.
[*] Your pet really likes birds and tries to chase them but luckily they will get away.
[*] If you have a stick in your hand, you can throw it (left-click). Your pet will bring it back to you and has a chance to gain friendship points. ([url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/322]original idea[/url]﻿)
[*] Getting hit by a tool or wet by your watering can will decrease the friendship. But you can say sorry by petting it again.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=4][b]
Uninstall[/b][/size][size=4][b]:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Remove the folder of this mod.
[/list]
Please note: Your pet is a bit wider than it seems. It cannot go vertically through spaces that are a single tile wide.
There is also a known issue that causes your pet to greet people in the town.
This is a vanilla feature making npcs greet each other randomly while walking by. I decided that this is not worth fixing since it would require changes that might lead to incompatibilities and bugs and it is also funny.


[size=4][b]Configuration:
[/b][/size]After you loaded the mod once, the configuration file config.json is created in the folder of the mod. Restart the game for your changes to take effect.
[list]
[*]"[b]pet_friendship_decrease_onhit[/b]":[i] default 20, friendship points that get subtracted if you hit your pet with a tool[/i]
[*]"[b]pet_fetch_friendship_chance[/b]": [i]default 40,  chance in % that playing fetch increases the friendship with your pet[/i]
[*]"[b]pet_fetch_friendship_increase[/b]": [i]default 10, friendship points that get added if you play fetch long enough[/i]
[*]"[b]pet_petting_friendship_increase[/b]": [i]default 12, friendship points that get added if you pet your pet[/i]
[*]"[b]stick_range[/b]": [i]default 12.0, throwing range of the stick in tiles[/i]
[*]"[b]show_message_on_warp[/b]": [i]default true, show a message after changing map and pet cannot follow (e.g. inside a house)[/i]
[*]"[b]unconditional_love[/b]": [i]default false, show "<pet> loves you" message every time you pet it[/i]
[*]"[b]love_everytime_at_max_friendship[/b]": [i]default false, show "<pet> loves you" message every time the friendship is at maximum and you pet it[/i]
[*]"[b]pet_speed[/b]": [i]default 6, value used internally (pixels per frame) to move the pet, this was the value that worked best for the animation[/i]
[*]"[b]pet_fast_speed[/b]": [i]default 10, same as pet_speed but for running[/i]
